commands.name: StartHost
commands.transaction_boundary: none across whole startup; migrations use their own atomic boundaries
steps: canonicalize paths without following an unexpected final symlink/reparse target
acquire exclusive data-instance lock before database migration/service
initialize bounded sanitized diagnostics
obtain live-data protection readiness from LLD-12
classify database state and initialize/migrate through MigrationRunner
run exact schema, FK, FK-index and append-only protection verification
create fresh LLD-12 run identity
pre-bind one exclusive 127.0.0.1 ephemeral socket
start single-worker Uvicorn on the already-owned socket
publish atomic minimal runtime registry only after server startup
perform authenticated self-health verification
report READY; browser launch is a packaging/launcher responsibility
commands.rollback: stop server if started; close socket/connections; remove only registry proven to belong to this run; release lock; never rewrite migration/audit evidence to hide failure

commands.name: ShutdownHost
commands.transaction_boundary: no new domain transaction may start after quiesce begins; existing authoritative units finish or roll back within bounded shutdown policy
steps: revalidate request against current run through LLD-12
set host state QUIESCING
reject new mutating application commands with HOST_QUIESCING
request background executors to stop accepting new work
wait boundedly for active units to complete/rollback
checkpoint WAL with TRUNCATE after authoritative connections are quiescent
close SQLite connections/executors
stop Uvicorn and close socket
remove runtime registry only if run/data identity still matches
release data-instance lock
report graceful result
commands.rule: forced process termination belongs to launcher/LLD-12 and requires fresh PID+birth revalidation

commands.name: ExecuteAuthoritativeCommand
steps: open verified authoritative connection
BEGIN IMMEDIATE
look up command_receipts by command_id
if same hash exists return prior result without new writes
if different hash exists fail integrity
load current target state
revalidate revision/domain preconditions
apply owning-domain mutation through repository interface
insert required lifecycle/domain evidence through owning domain
insert command_receipt
insert required audit event and audit_event_results
COMMIT
return committed result
commands.rollback: any failure before COMMIT executes ROLLBACK and leaves no receipt/audit/partial accepted mutation

commands.name: ApplyPendingMigrations
commands.transaction_boundary: one explicit atomic transaction per migration; clean initialization uses temporary unpublished database until full verification
steps: require data-instance ownership
verify migration files against manifest before mutation
read existing ledger/schema
classify missing/drift/future/order mismatch
for each pending migration BEGIN IMMEDIATE, execute parsed statements individually, insert exact ledger row, COMMIT
after final migration run exact schema/FK/FK-index/append-only checks
publish a newly initialized temporary database via atomic replacement only after all checks pass
commands.rollback: failed migration returns database to its prior committed version; failed clean initialization never replaces canonical database
